work_info.title: What is HDR Blending?
descriptions: HDR (High Dynamic Range) Blending is an advanced photo editing technique that combines multiple images of the same scene, captured at different exposures, into a single, perfectly balanced photograph. This ensures that bright highlights and deep shadows retain detail, creating clean, visually appealing real estate images.

list.content: Exposure Merging: Combining multiple shots to maintain details in both bright and dark areas.
Lighting Balance: Achieving natural interior and exterior illumination without overexposure.
Shadow & Highlight Enhancement: Preserving textures and fine details throughout the image.
Foundation for Virtual Staging: Providing realistic lighting and depth for digital furniture integration.
Contrast & Tone Optimization: Creating visually appealing, high-quality property visuals.
